scope: fixed-object deterministic correctness and source-operation controls; no timing or statistical inference
target_design: all d=1..10, target coordinates generated only in main driver; evaluator and solver never receive d
walk_rng: SplitMix64 Weyl increment 9e3779b97f4a7c15, multipliers bf58476d1ce4e5b9 and 94d049bb133111eb; exact rho.rs implementation
restart_design: restart 0..31; coin=restart_stream, each draw sets coin=mix(coin) then reduces modulo11; eight ordered jump coefficient pairs followed by one start pair; every pair evaluates [a]G+[b]Q. Actual used streams are retained in each row.
partition: eight bins from mix of canonical coordinate serialization and stream; negation canonicalization updates both scalar coefficients
pairing: Same source coordinates, master/effective seeds and ordered coefficient streams intentionally reused across three cold arms. Encodings and resulting walks may differ. Effective seed derivation is charged inside every arm.
order: oracle d ascending, master seeds in listed order, direct_E_rho then cubic_pullback_J_rho then prior_Gamma_J_rho; counts are deterministic, no walltime collected
retention: all prior rows and partial failed streams; no seed reroll, target exclusion, tuning, or hidden fallback
replay: portable independent same-source replay remains distinct from the first Cloud executable; exact mathematical outputs and counts required, heap layouts disclosed separately
held_out: none claimed; later generalization or performance needs fresh precommitted seeds and admission
seed_width_encoding: 64-bit unsigned values, sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits; arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64
domain_separation: target_seed(master,Q)=Elliptic::hash(Q,mix(master XOR 0x434d313943554231)); restart_stream=mix(mix(target_seed XOR 0x5245535441525431) XOR restart). Versioned roles bind study, coordinate target, replicate and restart.
duplicates: Before controls, require 1280 distinct target/master/restart stream IDs. Cross-arm reuse is intentional, not independent replication.
